title: Dedicated autoscaler: burst smoothing, priority routing, and utilization reporting improvements
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers observed sporadic latency spikes when many small bursts from high-priority tenants coincide with normal background traffic. Current token-bucket burst logic provides throughput guarantees but can cause short-term queueing for lower priority routes and lacks fine-grained telemetry for debugging. This PR implements three coordinated changes: 1) tokenbucket smoothing (exponential smoothing over burst windows) to avoid instant large token refills; 2) priority-aware routing within the fleet autoscaler so that guaranteed throughput bands are respected per-priority class and excess capacity is opportunistically used; 3) enhanced utilization reporting (per-route, per-priority, per-fleet) and new tracing hooks for burst events. Summary of changes: - core/autoscaler/tokenbucket: introduce SmoothedTokenBucket with configurable smoothing_alpha and burst_window_seconds and unit tests. - core/autoscaler/priority_routing: new routing policy that splits requests into guaranteed / opportunistic queues and exposes per-priority capacity reservations. - telemetry/metrics: add dedicated.autoscaler.burst_events, dedicated.autoscaler.utilization.{fleet,route,priority}, and tag enrichment for priority and capacity_tier. - api/v1/dedicated: add fields to FleetConfig: reserved_capacity_per_priority, burst_window_seconds, smoothing_alpha. - observability/dashboard: new Grafana panels and Loki query examples (dashboard JSON snippets) submitted under docs/observability. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind EXP_DD_AUTOSCALER_V2; gradual rollout to two Dedicated customers for a week, observe burst_events and utilization regressions, then enable by default. Backwards compatibility: default smoothing_alpha=1.0 (no smoothing), default reserved_capacity_per_priority omitted (legacy behavior preserved). Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for tokenbucket smoothing - [x] Integration tests for priority routing - [x] End-to-end smoke with Dedicated simulator - [x] Docs update + dashboard JSON - [x] Linear issues linked (ENG-1453, ENG-1499) Testing: added unit/integration tests and ran Dedicated canary test suite. Load tests show 12% reduction in 95th p99 tail latency for small-burst scenarios, median unchanged. Considerations: tuning defaults (smoothing_alpha=0.6, burst_window_seconds=15) were chosen after load experiments but might need customer-specific overrides. See release_notes for operator-visible changes and rollout steps.

review_comments: Carlos Alvarez: Can we make smoothing_alpha configurable per-fleet? I worry global defaults won't fit all customers. — author reply: yes, added reserved_capacity_per_priority and smoothing_alpha to FleetConfig so operators can tune per-fleet.

Priya Nair: The scheduler hook looks like it could add contention in the hot path; have you measured overhead? — author reply: microbenchmarks added (integration_tests/bench_scheduler.py) showing ~0.6% CPU overhead at 10k rps and no measurable latency regression under typical load. We also gate enforcement to only when reserved_capacity_per_priority is set.

Liam O'Connor: CI failure on first run was a linting error and a flaky test. Did you address the flakes? — author reply: fixed lint, added test stabilization in integration_tests/dedicated_autoscaler_smoke.py and retriggered CI; all checks green on rerun.

release_notes: Improved dedicated autoscaler behavior: added token-bucket smoothing, per-priority capacity reservations, and richer utilization telemetry. Operators can configure smoothing_alpha and burst_window_seconds per FleetConfig. Feature is behind EXP_DD_AUTOSCALER_V2 and will be gradually rolled out. See docs/observability/autoscaler_burst.md for dashboards and troubleshooting steps.
notes_for_ops: Default behavior unchanged unless FleetConfig.reserved_capacity_per_priority or EXP_DD_AUTOSCALER_V2 enabled. Recommend enabling in canary for 48-72 hours and monitoring dedicated.autoscaler.burst_events and dedicated.autoscaler.utilization.* metrics. If regressions observed, set smoothing_alpha back to 1.0 or reduce reserved capacities.
